description: Whether a stock exchange is open now or at a given time, from the exchange's own published hours and holidays: NYSE, Nasdaq, London (LSE), India (NSE, BSE), Pakistan (PSX), Nigeria (NGX), Johannesburg (JSE), Saudi (Tadawul), Dubai (DFM) and CME FX futures. Gives today's sessions in the exchange's local time, any holiday or early close, and the next ones. Leave "exchange" empty for every exchange plus forex and crypto.

at.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date and time (ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-27T15:00:00Z). Default: now.

exchange.description: An exchange name or code, for example "NYSE", "Nasdaq", "LSE" or "NSE". Leave empty for all.

name: is_market_open
title: Is a market open?
